scenes.narration: We asked three AI models for a link on twelve topics, then clicked every single one. Each one had to give a news article or a study.

scenes.narration: Google's Gemini Flash gave three dead links out of twelve. Google's Flash-Lite gave four dead links out of twelve. OpenAI's GPT-OSS gave five dead links out of twelve. That is twelve dead links out of thirty-six.
scenes.main_point: Show one square per link for each model, coloured opened, dead or unchecked, with the count
